title: Contrastive Attention Mitigates Spectral Bias in Spiking Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.01403v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spiking Transformers merge the energy-efficiency of spiking neural networks (SNNs) with the representational power of self-attention, creating a promising architecture for high-performance, energy-efficient computation. However, a performance gap persists versus its counterparts in artificial neural networks (ANNs). Unlike prior works attributing this to binary activations, we reveal that both spiking neurons and spiking self-attention (SSA) act as low-pass filters through multiscale spectral analysis. This characteristic leads to the dissipation of high-frequency components. To address this issue, we propose the Spiking Contrastive Attention (SCA) paradigm, which draw inspiration from the edge-detection and differential sensing properties of biological visual system. By extracting contrast prototypes via global contrastive aggregation and applying local differential refinement, SCA effectively enhances high-frequency information. Extens

translated_title: 对比注意力缓解脉冲Transformer中的频谱偏差
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.01403v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：脉冲Transformer将脉冲神经网络（SNN）的能效优势与自注意力的表征能力相结合，为高性能、低能耗计算提供了一种有前景的架构。然而，与人工神经网络（ANN）中的对应模型相比，其仍存在性能差距。与以往将这一差距归因于二值激活的工作不同，我们通过多尺度频谱分析揭示，脉冲神经元和脉冲自注意力（SSA）均起着低通滤波器的作用。这一特性导致高频分量的耗散。为解决这一问题，我们提出了脉冲对比注意力（SCA）范式，其灵感源自生物视觉系统的边缘检测和差分感知特性。通过全局对比聚合提取对比原型，并应用局部差分细化，SCA有效增强了高频信息。广泛的（实验验证……摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文通过多尺度频谱分析揭示脉冲Transformer中的脉冲神经元与脉冲自注意力本质上是导致高频信息耗散的低通滤波器，并提出受生物视觉系统启发的脉冲对比注意力（SCA）范式，借助全局对比聚合与局部差分细化增强高频信息，从而缓解频谱偏差、缩小与ANN的性能差距。
